name: Soundbeam 5
description: Accessible ultrasonic movement-to-MIDI instrument with switch inputs.
notice: Configure beam ranges, scales, MIDI channels and switch assignments on the Soundbeam. Connect its MIDI output through an interface to external sounds. Assignments depend on the setup; no universal note or CC map is supplied. This is Soundbeam 5, not Soundbeam 6. For computer use, connect MIDI OUT to interface MIDI IN; connect interface MIDI OUT to hardware MIDI IN when controlling the instrument. Port names are intentionally empty: interface or app names do not reliably identify the attached hardware. Select this profile manually. This is partial coverage, not a complete MIDI implementation. The panel is an original schematic; virtual keyboard note numbers are illustrative and require MIDI learn or octave adjustment.
